text:
rachel: Noticed an odd inversion on the latency dashboards for /v1/generate: p95 line drops below p50 right after we enabled continuous-batching optimizations at 10:14 UTC. snapshot: https://img.redwood.internal/continuous-batch.png :thinking:
pete: Whoa. Which panel and aggregation? raw vs sketch?
rachel: The panel is the percentile timeseries that reads stored t-digest rollups for 1h. No special filtering. Time window 09:30-10:30.
anika: Two usual suspects: (1) small-sample shards with many ultra-low latencies (fast-batch short-circuits) skew merged centroids, (2) inconsistent sampling between per-endpoint rollups and global rollups after batching changes.
pete: Can you paste the debug query you ran?
rachel: Sure:
```
-- per-shard debug
SELECT shard_id, count(*) AS n, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.5) AS p50, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) AS p95
FROM latency_events
WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND time >= now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY shard_id;
```

rachel: Results: shard-9 n=28 p50=12ms p95=20ms; shard-2 n=2200 p50=210ms p95=480ms. Merged tdigest showed p95~30ms and p50~200ms for the endpoint slice.
anika: Yep classic centroid-domination: small shard with tiny centroid(s) got merged and due to compression/centroid placement pulled the high quantiles down.
pete: Short-term proposal: UI should surface per-slice sample_count and a confidence pill next to percentile labels (high/med/low). When confidence=low, show a tooltip explaining sketch-merge artifacts and suggest raw-scan steps. Also add a dashboard annotation at the time we flipped batching.
anika: Backend short-term: if slice_sample_count < 300, compute exact percentiles from raw events instead of using merged t-digests. Longer-term: store a compact exact-summary (e.g., sampled raw quantiles or small HDR) per interval so the UI can deterministically show monotonic percentiles at display granularity.
pete: UX detail: add an overlay line for sample_count (dashed) and gray-out percentile lines that are low confidence. That should reduce support noise.
rachel: I'll add an incident note and tag production owners. Also we should avoid hiding p99 entirely — better to show it but with the low-confidence flag.
annotation-bot: annotation added: "continuous-batching-rollout" at 2025-03-12T10:14:00Z by rachel.
opsbot: deploy-bot: CL-4601 opened by pete for console: sample_count pill + confidence badge. CI queued. :rocket:
pete: I'll open the backend PR for the low-N exact-compute guard and add tests demonstrating non-monotonicity with synthetic tdigest merges.
anika: I'll draft the runbook blurb "percentile non-monotonicity" with repro steps: 1) run per-shard count + exact percentiles, 2) check for fast-batch client ids, 3) compare rollup vs raw. Put the mitigation list (annotate, compute exact for low-N, exclude fast-path from rollups) in the doc.
rachel: Thanks. Keeping watch on customer-facing signals; will roll back batching for a small percentage if we see latency regressions or customer tickets spike. :eyes:
